title: Take a course on renting in NSW
summary: Take the free online Rent It Keep It (RIKI) course to learn about renting in NSW and receive a certificate of completion.
intro:
Rent It Keep It (RIKI) is a free online training course about renting in NSW. This self-paced course takes about 2 hours to complete and covers:

The course is available in Arabic, Cantonese, English, Filipino, Hindu, Mandarin and Vietnamese.

Once you finish the course, you’ll receive a certificate of completion which can be used to support your rental applications.
who_can_apply: People with a limited rental history
People who have had issues with a rental tenancy in the past
People looking for up-to-date information about renting in NSW
what_you_need: A Rent It Keep It Account

how_to_steps.text: Log in, or create your Rent It Keep It Account.
Follow the prompts to take the course.

more_info.text: refer to Rent it Keep it (RIKI), or
contact Homes NSW or your nearest community housing provider.
